item.title: The next wars are always here
item.description: Because the next wars were always here, looming. We just need the clarity to see them and the force to stop them before they begin.

item.title: Sanders demands senate scrutiny of RFK Jr. over war on science
item.description: Senate Democrats say Kennedy has undermined scientific agencies as preventable diseases surge.

item.title: We need to know how corporate Democrats made President Trump possible
item.description: Scrutinizing them now is vital not only for clarity about the past. It also makes possible a clear focus on ways to prevent further catastrophe.

item.title: History tells us…there’s hope
item.description: The answer to “who can save our country?” is in the mirror.
